# The Little Book of Semaphores {#preface .unnumbered}

This is a **Quarto HTML scaffold** for *The Little Book of Semaphores*
(Task 22). It is not yet a full port of the LaTeX book under
[`book/`](../book/).

## What this project is for

- Produce a navigable HTML book that can later host **embedded Sync**
  examples (Tasks 23–26).
- Mirror the Think Java 2 pattern: Quarto book under `quarto/`, Sync web
  assets under `web/`, engine under `code/`.

## Build

Quarto is installed separately ([get started](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/)).
From the repository root:

```bash
make html          # quarto render → quarto/_book/
make html-preview  # quarto preview
```

Or from this directory:

```bash
quarto render
quarto preview
```

## LaTeX → Quarto (later)

The published PDF still builds from [`book/book.tex`](../book/book.tex).
When we convert chapters, we expect to adapt scripts from Think Java 2
(`ThinkJava2/quarto/convert.py`, `split_book.py`, and related Makefile
targets)—not invent a new pipeline from scratch.
